title: Preflight offers the SSH-pushurl fix for a SAML org and install --apply sets it
description: A checkout whose origin fetches over SSH from a remote refusing with a SAML SSO message (a stub ssh behind core.sshCommand): the install preflight names the pushurl-only fix — git remote set-url --push origin git@github.com:OWNER/REPO.git with an https fetch URL — and --push-auth gh, install --apply sets both URLs, and a re-run stops naming it. Under --push-auth gh no Repository check runs, and a non-SAML refusal changes nothing.
